login.title: F/A-18 Super Hornet
login.sub: Combat-proven, multirole, networked carrier fighter. Sign in to access program systems.
login.cardSub: Use your Boeing identity or a demonstration account.

signup.title: Request program access
signup.sub: Submit your details. A notification is sent to the program access contact.
signup.cardSub: Your request is emailed to the program access contact.

signupSent.title: Request sent
signupSent.sub: An email with your details was sent to the configured program access contact. They will follow up if access can be granted.
signupSent.subNotify: An email with your details was sent to {notifyEmail}. They will follow up if access can be granted.

success.title: You’re signed in
success.sub: {name} has access to Super Hornet program systems for this session.

denied.title: This account is not authorized
denied.sub: Your identity was verified, but this account does not have access to F/A-18 program systems. Request access from your program administrator if you need it.

loggedOut.title: You have signed out
loggedOut.sub: Your program session on this device has ended. Sign in again when you need access.

email.subject: Program access request: {name}
